thread:
Irene (Partnerships): Vendor just sent a last-minute SKU rename for the APAC wave: `B200-slim-16` -> `B200-slim-16A` and wants one manifest for all regions. SI is asking for region-tagged availability. Need a quick decision before we freeze marketplace copy.
Kai (Platform): We can support a single manifest with region metadata + alias mapping (canonical -> [aliases]) so old strings still resolve. That avoids duplicate listings.
Lola (Marketing): Localization already started; any SKU tweak breaks TMs. Can we freeze copy to family names ("B200 family") and swap exact SKUs on signed manifest publish?
Ethan (Finance): Billing needs canonical strings by Monday EOD to reconcile invoices. If vendor changes `-16` vs `-16A` we get charge disputes. We should accept aliases temporarily but tag canonical for ledger.
Rina (SI): APAC dry-run depends on driver signing. If the vendor publishes signed artifacts late, APAC onboarding slips by a week. SI recommends a staggered availability footprint with NA/EU first.
vendor-ci-bot: Vendor published unsigned artifact: https://vendor.example/gaudi/hotfix-2026-05-10.tar.gz (checksum pending).
Kai (Platform): Unsigned won't pass our CI gating. Ask vendor for signed container + SHA256. Once we have it, rebuild + smoke is ~28-36h.
Irene (Partnerships): Quick ask to vendor (in DM): can you publish signed container and confirm canonical SKUs? We need both to finalize marketplace manifest and marketing localization.
Lola (Marketing): If signed container misses our freeze, we publish with generic family names + "rolling availability" footnote. PR team prefers single headline so we'll include per-region availability in a table.
Ethan (Finance): I'll prepare billing alias mapping (canonical -> old strings) and push a PR; need vendor confirmation to merge. Tagging finance for review.
Rina (SI): Proposed cadence: vendor signed container by Fri 12:00 UTC, CI smoke Fri evening, NA/EU dry-run Mon, APAC dry-run Tue (if signed). If vendor misses, we stagger announce and mark APAC as "availability: rolling".
Kai (Platform): Also flag: MI300 quantized path shows a 3% perf delta on our internal harness with current kernels. If vendor runtime patch changes numbers, we should include a short perf note in the embargo pack.
Irene (Partnerships): Meeting in 20 to confirm: agenda - canonical SKUs, signed artifact, marketing freeze, billing alias PR, SI dry-run windows. I'll loop vendor PM.
vendor-ci-bot: Noted. Vendor PM replied in DM: "Canonical SKUs: H200-48G-v2, MI300-128A, B200-slim-16A. Signed container will be published by 2026-05-10T10:00:00Z with SHA256 in release note."
Kai (Platform): Good. Once signed image is up I'll kick CI. Expect smoke + perf note in ~30h.
Lola (Marketing): Locking localization until CI green and signed manifest live. Draft embargo pack in internal drive with placeholders for SKUs: https://redwood.example/embargo/sku_hold_v1.md.
Ethan (Finance): Drafted billing alias PR and added fallback aliases for older strings. Will not merge until vendor confirms canonical list.
Rina (SI): SI confirmed dry-run teams for NA/EU. APAC team on standby pending signed artifact.
Irene (Partnerships): Great. Actions: Vendor - publish signed container + release SHA; Platform - CI smoke and tag derated nodes if microcode pending; Marketing - freeze copy and prepare per-region availability table; Finance - ready PR for alias mapping. We'll reconvene if any slip.
